causal_hypothesis: A single row-owned finalizer after the unchanged FP8 down-projection can retain the two BF16 rounding boundaries in shared memory, persist only the next-layer residual, and emit the next layer's exact dynamic-E4M3 input and scale. This removes two launches and the normalized-BF16 global store/read/re-read path without duplicating the down GEMM.
expected_direction: Lower boundary traffic and launch count than the materialized control; identical reference residual, E4M3 bytes, scale bits, and sampled first-consumer BF16 fragments.
stock_control: Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 FP8 down GEMM -> gemma_rmsnorm_residual_scalar -> next RMSNorm -> per_token_quant_fp8_small_batch_kernel -> unchanged QKV fp8_scaled_mm.
candidate_change: Keep the stock down GEMM and fuse only post-FF RMSNorm, residual/scalar, next input RMSNorm, and dynamic E4M3 production into one row-owned SM90a finalizer.

scope.dtype_contract: dynamic per-token E4M3FN activations and per-channel E4M3FN weights; FP32 scales; BF16 down, residual, normalized boundary, and QKV output

quality_and_correctness_gates: Control and candidate required residual BF16 bytes are identical.
Control and candidate next-normalized BF16 bytes are identical under the registered deterministic reduction tree.
Control and candidate FP32 scale bits and complete E4M3 bytes are identical, including all-zero and signed-zero rows.
Eight Q/K/V-spanning sampled first-consumer BF16 columns are identical.
No down-projection FLOP duplication and no precision, scale-granularity, tensor-parallel, or CUDA-graph semantic change.

slo.component: Candidate compulsory boundary bytes must be lower than control and launch count must fall from three post-down producer launches to one.
slo.whole_request: Report a source/telemetry-bounded ceiling against 0.625149101968745 seconds/request; do not claim measured endpoint or component latency.

budget.cleanup: No external resources or background processes; retain only project-local source and compact JSON/stdout artifacts.

baseline_and_attribution.method: Read-only kernel totals and source-derived exact invocation geometry; count only non-overlapping post-down launches in the candidate boundary.
baseline_and_attribution.residual_bottleneck: Both the stock down GEMM and next QKV GEMM remain unchanged; candidate scope is only the inter-GEMM row dataflow.

proxy_fidelity.class: deterministic CPU/reference fragment oracle plus analytical SM90a resource/traffic model
proxy_fidelity.transfer_limit: No target-hardware latency, compiler resource, CUTLASS FastAccum-order, or endpoint claim. Promotion requires the separately emitted exact-consumer H200 contract.
